notes: P67137fb87b G4. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.' Keldon Raider is seat 0's only card in hand, so after it is cast the hand is empty and no card can be discarded: 'If you do' is false (CR 118.12) and no card is drawn, even if seat 0 answers the may with fire.
